hypothesis.statement: The pivot reading is CONFIRMED and the declaration channel is proved closed, so the next lane must not re-run declaration or hint levers on `zero`. What is left, and what this lane did not probe, is the OTHER end of the pivot: the target's scratch triple starts at f1 because f0 is occupied by `zero`, and ours starts at f0 because f7 is. Rather than trying to push `zero` down to f0, push the SCRATCH up -- the scratch triple is the delta accumulation `delta[i] += c->knockbackVelocity[i] * gClockFrameStep;` whose three loads at 0x204/0x208/0x20c our build colours f1/f2/f0 and the target colours f2/f3/f1. A source form that lengthens or splits one of those three short webs (for instance naming the gClockFrameStep read once into a local read by all three statements, so its web spans the whole accumulation instead of being rematerialised per statement) changes how many scratch registers are simultaneously live at 0x1f8, which is the only quantity that plausibly decides whether the allocator hands `zero` the lowest free volatile or the highest.
